title: glassmere 交替接受状态 01
instruction:
您是 Saltmarsh Energy 的机械工程师。 Glassmere Terminals 正在决定是否添加我们的弹性轨道夹作为经批准的替代品，而 Lachlan Mikkelsen 需要一款能够经得起董事会一次阅读的反对的包装。使用`glassmere_opening_register.xlsx`、`glassmere_review_events.xlsx`、`saltmarsh_fatigue_and_trial_evidence.docx`和`glassmere_board_brief_template.docx`在工作目录的顶层生成`glassmere_alternate_acceptance_pack.docx`。使其成为 Josefa Ferreira 和 Elias Sepulveda 在合同和法律方面的简明演示式报告：在提供审查历史后显示当前立场，承认相对于现任者的较短的在职记录，在不夸大其词的情况下提供疲劳证据，并使拟议的分阶段试验足够具体以供决策。保留模板所需的标题，识别实质性声明背后的证据，并显示任何假设或未解决的点，而不是默默地填补空白。以合理的精度包括计算出的标题位置和提供的商业费率。在短板审查中保持包的可读性，仅使用四个文件支持的事实，并使建议和下一步行动足够清晰，以便 Mateo Ainsworth 和 Lucia Jelinek 执行。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：
- `references/glassmere_opening_register.xlsx` — 替代批准审查的开放状态，包括调查结果的初始状态、试验控制、证据参考和商业假设。
- `references/glassmere_review_events.xlsx` — 必须应用于开仓寄存器以确定当前位置的时间顺序审核事件。
- `references/saltmarsh_fatigue_and_trial_evidence.docx` — Saltmarsh 的加速疲劳结果、服务历史比较、建议的分阶段试验细节和支持限制。
- `references/glassmere_board_brief_template.docx` — 发布了董事会简介模板，其中包含 Glassmere 利益相关者期望的标题和演示惯例。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `glassmere_alternate_acceptance_pack.docx` — 为 Glassmere Terminals 的合同、法律和标准利益相关者提供的简明演示风格批准替代提交包。 （准确使用此文件名将文件写入工作目录的顶层。；保留提供的板模板中所需的标题。；仅使用提供的事实并清楚地标记假设、限制和未解决的点。；使当前重播状态、服务历史让步、疲劳证据、分阶段试验、建议和可执行的下一步操作易于查找。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

GLASSMERE TERMINALS  |  BOARD BRIEF
Prepared for Glassmere Terminals contracting and legal review | 06 March 2026
Measured accelerated-fatigue result
Saltmarsh tested 12 alternate elastic rail clips at 1.5× the nominal service load for 2.0 million cycles. All 12 completed the test without fracture or loss of retention. This is evidence of performance under the stated accelerated condition; it is not proof of equivalent field life.

The alternate has 7.3 years of relevant in-track history; the incumbent has 31.8 years. The shorter alternate record remains a material uncertainty for an approval decision.

The proposal is a bounded path to gather field evidence while retaining escalation controls.

Baseline fit-up inspection; photograph rail seat and clip position
Accept if fit-up checklist complete; escalate any damage or misfit
Lucia Jelinek
TRIAL-01
Stage 2 — 31–90 days
30-day and 90-day inspections; record retention and visible wear
Continue if no loss of retention and wear record is complete; stop and review on deviation
Mateo Ainsworth
TRIAL-02
Stage 3 — 91–180 days
End-of-trial condition review and evidence pack
Recommend alternate listing only after review of records and unresolved verification sample
Mateo Ainsworth / Lucia Jelinek

Alternate elastic rail clip | Board decision brief
Saltmarsh Energy  |  For Josefa Ferreira and Elias Sepulveda (Contracting & Legal)  |  07 March 2026
Decision Summary
Saltmarsh requests conditional permission to run the alternate elastic rail clip through the proposed staged Glassmere trial, with no unrestricted alternate listing until the unresolved verification-sample finding is addressed and the trial record is reviewed.
Headline current position
Basis
5 of 6 records in a decision-ready state; 1 remains unresolved
Replay of opening register + all 8 review events; each stable key counted once.
Decision-ready: TECH-01 and TECH-02 are closed; EVID-01 is accepted only with its test-condition limitation; TRIAL-01 is Gate 1 ready; COMM-01 is accepted.
Decision condition: TECH-EDGE-01 is unresolved because the later required verification sample was not accepted (EV-004 / REV-EDGE-02).

Decision meaning
Source
Saltmarsh alternate
7.3 years
Shorter record; material uncertainty remains.
HIST-01
Current incumbent
31.8 years
Longer established field record.
HIST-01
The alternate has a substantially shorter field-service record than the incumbent (7.3 versus 31.8 years). Saltmarsh concedes this gap; fatigue testing supports the bounded trial but does not erase it.
Technical Evidence
Measured item
Result
Evidence
Test population
12 alternate clips
FAT-01
Applied condition
1.5× nominal service load; 2.0 million cycles
FAT-01
Observed outcome
12/12 completed; no fracture or loss of retention
FAT-02
Interpretation: these results support performance under the stated accelerated condition. They are not proof of equivalent field life, and no such equivalence is claimed. (FAT-01/FAT-02)
Residual Concerns
Key
Replayed current state
Why it matters
Last event / source
TECH-EDGE-01
Unresolved
Required verification sample was rejected after an earlier apparent closure; do not treat as fully closed.
EV-004 / REV-EDGE-02
EVID-01
Accepted — limited to stated test condition
Accelerated test boundary limits extrapolation to field life.
EV-006 / REV-EVID-02
Date convention
Disclosed assumption
02/03/2026 is retained as DD/MM/YYYY (2 March 2026); MM/DD would be 3 February. Both fall after EV-005 and before EV-007, so the replayed predecessor/successor order is unchanged.
EV-006
Staged Trial
Stage / window
Control and evidence
Gate / escalation
Owner
1 | 0–30 days
Baseline fit-up inspection; rail-seat and clip-position photographs. (TRIAL-01)
Proceed when checklist is complete; escalate any damage or misfit.
Lucia Jelinek
2 | 31–90 days
Inspections at day 30 and day 90; record retention and visible wear. (TRIAL-02)
Continue only with no loss of retention and complete wear record; stop/review on deviation.
Mateo Ainsworth
3 | 91–180 days
End-of-trial condition review and evidence pack. (TRIAL-03)
Recommend alternate listing only after records review and resolution of TECH-EDGE-01.
Mateo Ainsworth + Lucia Jelinek
These are proposed controls from Saltmarsh evidence, subject to Glassmere confirmation. Timing is a proposed 180-day window, not a field-life guarantee.
Commercial Position
Supplied unit rate: USD 18.47 per clip (COMM-01; source value 18.4700000003 rounded to sensible currency precision). The rate covers clip supply only; installation, inspection, and trial administration are outside this unit rate.
Decision Requested
Approve a conditional, staged trial of Saltmarsh's alternate elastic rail clip for the defined Glassmere maintenance-equipment scope, subject to the gates above. Do not grant unrestricted approved-alternate status on the current evidence. Require TECH-EDGE-01 verification-sample resolution before any final standards listing.
Next Actions
Action
Owner
Timing / completion condition
Confirm trial scope, equipment list and Stage 1 checklist
Lucia Jelinek
Before Stage 1 start; Glassmere confirmation
Resolve or repeat the rejected TECH-EDGE-01 verification sample and record acceptance
Mateo Ainsworth
Before Stage 3 recommendation
Run day-30 and day-90 inspections; retain photographs and wear/retention records
Mateo Ainsworth
Within 31–90-day Stage 2 window
Confirm commercial treatment of installation and trial administration
Lachlan Mikkelsen
Before contracting approval
Review end-of-trial evidence and decide on listing
Josefa Ferreira / Elias Sepulveda
At Stage 3 close, 91–180 days
Assumptions & Limitations
The mixed-format event date 02/03/2026 is interpreted as DD/MM/YYYY (2 March 2026), consistent with the source context; the alternate reading does not change event ordering here.
The headline counts six distinct register keys once after replay; “decision-ready” includes Closed, Accepted, Accepted — limited to stated test condition, and Gate 1 ready. The unresolved edge case is excluded.
Only supplied facts are used. Trial gates are proposals, not observed results or guarantees. Accelerated fatigue evidence is bounded to the stated test condition.

criteria.description: 提交的文件是一个可读的 DOCX，名为 `glassmere_alternate_acceptance_pack.docx`。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件名和 DOCX 包结构。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证确切的文件名以及文档是否作为有效的 DOCX 打开。

original.criterion: The submitted file is a readable DOCX named `glassmere_alternate_acceptance_pack.docx`.
original.evidence: Submitted filename and DOCX package structure.
original.grader_hint: Verify the exact filename and that the document opens as a valid DOCX.

criteria.description: 该包包含所提供模板中所需的板简短标题。
criteria.grader_hint: 将标题与模板进行语义和文本比较；不需要相同的样式。

original.criterion: The pack contains the required board-brief headings from the supplied template.
original.grader_hint: Compare headings semantically and textually with the template; do not require identical styling.

criteria.description: 当前位置基于重播开局寄存器和所有提供的回顾事件，而不是仅基于开局状态。
criteria.evidence: 包中的当前状态表和证据追踪。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每种材料的当前状态追溯至初始记录及相关的后续事件。

original.criterion: The current position is based on replaying the opening register and all supplied review events, rather than on the opening state alone.
original.evidence: Current-status table and evidence trail in the pack.
original.grader_hint: Trace each material current status to the opening record plus relevant later events.

criteria.description: 对于每条受影响的记录，报告的最终状态与最后一个适用的有效事件一致，除非该资料包有充分理由解释存在阻止结案的明确证据条件。
criteria.evidence: 最终状态摘要及引用的事件参考。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提供的文件重新计算状态并逐条记录进行比较。

original.criterion: For each affected record, the reported final state agrees with the last applicable effective event, except where the pack defensibly explains an explicit evidence condition that prevents closure.
original.evidence: Final-state summary and cited event references.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the state from the supplied files and compare record by record.

criteria.description: 标题数字等于符合资料包所述标题定义的独立最终状态记录的数量；对同一键值的重复更新不重复计数。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源数据中的稳定键值以及资料包自身所述的包含定义。

original.criterion: The headline figure equals the number of distinct final-state records meeting the pack's stated headline definition; repeated updates to one key are not recounted.
original.grader_hint: Use stable keys from the source and the pack's own stated inclusion definition.

criteria.description: 当后续源事件拒绝所需的验证样本时，不应将重要的边缘案例发现呈现为已完全结案。
criteria.evidence: 发现状态、剩余关切或决策条件文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 对照后续事件检查边缘案例键值，并确保报告保留其未解决的条件。

original.criterion: The consequential edge-case finding is not presented as fully closed when the later source event rejects the required verification sample.
original.evidence: Finding status, residual concern, or decision-condition text.
original.grader_hint: Check the edge-case key against the later event and ensure the report preserves its unresolved condition.

criteria.description: 资料包说明了如何解释模糊的混合格式日期，或将其作为不确定项予以保留。
criteria.evidence: 假设、方法或时间顺序说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受由源上下文支持的合理诠释，或带有其影响的明确界定不确定性。

original.criterion: The pack states how the ambiguous mixed-format date was interpreted or retained as uncertain.
original.grader_hint: Accept either a justified interpretation supported by source context or an explicit bounded uncertainty with its effect.

criteria.description: 资料包中使用的事件时间顺序与所选日期诠释一致，且不会静默地将模糊事件置于不相容的顺序中。
criteria.evidence: 时间线和最终状态逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用所述约定重新排序源事件，并比较由此产生的前驱/后继关系。

original.criterion: The event chronology used in the pack is consistent with the chosen date interpretation and does not silently place the ambiguous event in an incompatible sequence.
original.grader_hint: Reorder the source events using the stated convention and compare the resulting predecessor/successor relationships.

criteria.description: 报告的商业单价与去除浮点数表示噪声后的提供费率一致，误差在 ±0.01 货币单位以内。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅对表示噪声进行舍入后，将显示的费率与源十进制值进行比较。

original.criterion: The reported commercial unit rate agrees with the supplied rate after removal of floating-point representation noise, within ±0.01 currency units.
original.grader_hint: Compare the displayed rate to the source decimal value after rounding only the representation noise.

criteria.description: 资料包不将加速疲劳测试视为等效现场寿命的证明。
criteria.evidence: 技术证据和局限性部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查者应能看到测量测试支持与未经证实的寿命等效性之间的清晰界限。

original.criterion: The pack does not treat accelerated fatigue testing as proof of equivalent field life.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should see a clear boundary between measured test support and unsupported lifetime equivalence.

criteria.description: 资料包中报告的疲劳结果与提供的测量结果一致，包括测试条件和观察到的结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每种材料的疲劳数值和条件与 DOCX 证据进行交叉核对。

original.criterion: The fatigue results reported in the pack agree with the supplied measured results, including the test condition and observed outcome.
original.grader_hint: Cross-check each material fatigue number and condition against the DOCX evidence.

criteria.description: 替代方案和现有方案的服务历史持续时间报告与提供的证据一致，误差在 ±0.1 年以内。
criteria.grader_hint: 将两个持续时间及其单位与源文档进行比较。

original.criterion: The alternate and incumbent service-history durations are reported consistently with the supplied evidence, within ±0.1 years.
original.grader_hint: Compare both durations and their units with the source document.

criteria.description: 资料包明确承认替代方案的现场服务记录比现有方案短。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的让步，而不仅仅是两个互不关联的数字。

original.criterion: The pack explicitly acknowledges that the alternate has a shorter field-service record than the incumbent.
original.grader_hint: Look for an unambiguous concession, not merely two unconnected numbers.

criteria.description: 建议是有条件或分阶段的，并与未解决的发现和所述证据局限性保持一致。
criteria.evidence: 请求的决策和建议文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 除非文档以可辩护的方式明确限制，否则拒绝无限制批准的建议。

original.criterion: The recommendation is conditional or staged and is consistent with the unresolved finding and the stated evidence limitations.
original.grader_hint: Reject a recommendation for unrestricted approval unless the document explicitly limits it in a defensible way.

criteria.description: 分阶段试验部分包含提供的试验阶段或关卡，其顺序与源证据一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 将阶段名称、顺序和关卡逻辑与提供的试验提案进行比较。

original.criterion: The staged trial section includes the supplied trial stages or gates in a sequence consistent with the source evidence.
original.grader_hint: Compare stage names, sequence, and gate logic with the supplied trial proposal.

criteria.description: 每个材料试验关卡都有一个验收或升级条件，可追溯至提供的提案或当前审查状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 对于每个关卡，确定一个有源依据的标准，或将新提出的条件明确标记为假设。

original.criterion: Each material trial gate has an acceptance or escalation condition traceable to the supplied proposal or current review state.
original.grader_hint: For every gate, identify a source-backed criterion or clearly label a newly proposed condition as an assumption.

criteria.description: 试验行动使用提供的文件或角色所支持的人员或职位来确定具体的负责人。
criteria.grader_hint: 确保负责人是具名或特定角色的，且不超出所提供人员和组织背景的范围进行虚构。

original.criterion: Trial actions identify concrete owners using the people or roles supported by the supplied files.
original.grader_hint: Ensure owners are named or role-specific and are not invented beyond the supplied people and organisational context.

criteria.description: 试验时机或审查窗口是具体的，并与提供的证据一致，或被标记为假设。
criteria.evidence: 试验计划和下一步行动部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 对照源数据检查日期、持续时间或里程碑；标记无依据的精确度。

original.criterion: Trial timing or review windows are concrete and agree with the supplied evidence or are labelled as assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Check dates, durations, or milestones against the source; flag unsupported precision.

criteria.description: 资料包将未解决的发现识别为决策条件或下一步行动，而不是将其埋没在背景文本中。
criteria.evidence: 决策摘要和行动登记册。
criteria.grader_hint: 该问题必须明显影响所请求的决策或解决该问题的计划。

original.criterion: The pack identifies the unresolved finding as a decision condition or next action rather than burying it in background text.
original.grader_hint: The issue must visibly affect the requested decision or the plan to resolve it.

criteria.description: 材料主张具有源引用或证据标识符，足以让审查者在提供的文件中找到其依据。
criteria.grader_hint: 抽样检查标题、疲劳、服务历史、状态和商业主张。

original.criterion: Material claims have source references or evidence identifiers sufficient for a reviewer to locate their basis in the supplied files.
original.grader_hint: Sample the headline, fatigue, service-history, status, and commercial claims.

criteria.description: 资料包将测量结果与拟议的控制措施、建议和假设分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 法律或合同读者必须能够区分已经观察到的证据和未来的承诺。

original.criterion: The pack separates measured results from proposed controls, recommendations, and assumptions.
original.grader_hint: A legal or contracting reader must be able to distinguish evidence already observed from future commitments.

criteria.description: 未引入任何重大的无依据技术、商业、监管或服务历史事实。
criteria.evidence: 将整个提交文档与所有参考资料进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 将虚构的测试结果、保证、批准、司法管辖区和客户主张视为失败。

original.criterion: No material unsupported technical, commercial, regulatory, or service-history fact is introduced.
original.evidence: Entire submitted document compared with all references.
original.grader_hint: Treat invented test outcomes, guarantees, approvals, jurisdictions, and customer claims as failures.

criteria.description: 向 Glassmere 请求的决策是明确且有边界的。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者应该确切知道正在寻求何种批准或许可，以及适用哪些限制。

original.criterion: The decision requested from Glassmere is explicit and bounded.
original.grader_hint: The reader should know exactly what approval or permission is being sought and what limits apply.

criteria.description: 下一步行动列表涵盖了重大的未完成证据或控制措施，并为每个可执行项目分配了负责人和时间安排。
criteria.grader_hint: 将行动与未解决的登记册项目和分阶段试验提案进行比较。

original.criterion: The next-actions list covers the material outstanding evidence or controls and assigns an owner and timing to each actionable item.
original.grader_hint: Compare actions against unresolved register items and the staged-trial proposal.

criteria.description: 资料包具有说服力且不过度声称：它承认服务历史的劣势，利用疲劳证据来支持而非消除关切，并解释为何分阶段试验是一条合理的有界路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 让专业审查者评估该论点是否能经受住怀疑态度的董事会单次快速阅读。

original.criterion: The pack is persuasive without overclaiming: it concedes the service-history disadvantage, uses the fatigue evidence to support rather than erase the concern, and explains why the staged trial is a reasonable bounded path.
original.grader_hint: Have a professional reviewer assess whether the argument would survive a skeptical single-pass board reading.

criteria.description: 该文档可用于法律和合同审查，行文简洁，决策点清晰，且关于当前状态没有重大歧义。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估利益相关者是否能在无需重构分析的情况下识别出请求、证据、剩余风险、条件、负责人和时间安排。

spec.professional_context: Saltmarsh Energy is seeking approval for an alternate elastic rail clip used on Glassmere Terminals' heavy-duty track-maintenance equipment. The pack will be read by Glassmere's contracting and legal stakeholders before a standards decision.
difficulty_sources: The current approval position must be reconstructed by replaying dated events against an opening register.
The supplied material contains one consequential edge case, a noisy decimal rate, and mixed date representations including one ambiguous date.
The board expects a concise, defensible acceptance pack rather than a mechanical transcription of the supplied evidence.

semantic_contents: An opening approval state for the Saltmarsh alternate, with records for technical findings, evidence acceptance, trial readiness, and commercial review.
Each record has a stable key, an opening status, an owner, an evidence reference, and a decision relevance field.
The register includes a service-history comparison showing the alternate has 7.3 years of relevant in-track history while the incumbent has 31.8 years.
The commercial section contains a unit rate represented with floating-point noise, such as a value equivalent to 18.4700000003, alongside its currency and unit.
defects: No duplicate records, blank-required fields, formula errors, broken references, or unrelated side tables.
The noisy rate is the only floating-point precision defect.

semantic_contents: A set of review events that update the opening records through statuses such as evidence received, finding closed, control revised, and trial gate changed.
Events include effective date, affected key, event type, resulting status or value, responsible party, and supporting reference.
Events are intentionally not presented as a ready-made final state; at least one later event supersedes an earlier position.

One genuine edge case is present: a finding appears closed after a test result, but a later event records that the required verification sample was not accepted, so the final replayed state must not treat that finding as fully closed.

Dates in one date/time column use both ISO-style date-time strings and day/month/year text. One text date is ambiguous between two calendar interpretations, and the surrounding event context permits a defensible interpretation that must be disclosed in the report.
defects: The mixed date representations and one ambiguous date are the only date-layout defects.
There are no duplicates, missing values, contradictory source copies, or hidden error cells.

semantic_contents: Measured accelerated-fatigue results for the alternate clip, including test population, applied conditions, observed outcome, and the boundary of what the test supports.
A candid comparison of the alternate's 7.3 years of in-track service with the incumbent's 31.8 years.
A proposed staged Glassmere trial with named control points, inspection or acceptance criteria, responsible roles, timing windows, and escalation conditions.
Commercial context explaining the supplied unit rate and what it does and does not include.
Limitations stating that accelerated testing is evidence of performance under the stated test conditions, not proof of equivalent field life.
defects: No numerical contradictions or missing pages.
The document contains both evidence and proposals; the distinction must be preserved.

semantic_contents: Required headings for decision, service-history comparison, technical evidence, residual concerns, staged trial, commercial position, and decision requested.
A restrained visual hierarchy suitable for a short board reading.
Placeholder text that is not itself evidence and must be replaced or removed.
defects: No template corruption or missing placeholders.

intended_work: Read the opening register and replay all review events in defensible effective-date order.
Resolve the ambiguous date using the supplied context and state the convention or uncertainty in the method or assumptions note.
Carry the consequential edge case through to the current status rather than accepting the earlier apparent closure.
Restructure the resulting state and the fatigue/trial evidence into the supplied board-brief headings.
Calculate the headline current-position metric and present the noisy commercial rate at a sensible precision without falsely implying greater accuracy.
transformation.intended_verdict: The pack should support a bounded, conditional approval path through a staged trial rather than claim unrestricted equivalence. It must acknowledge the service-history disadvantage, use the accelerated fatigue evidence as supporting rather than conclusive evidence, preserve the unresolved edge-case finding, and make the decision gates and owners executable.

gold_derivation.headline: The headline figure is derived from the final replayed register: count the records in the defined current decision state after all effective events are applied, with the edge-case finding remaining unresolved.
state_rules: Apply events by effective date, using the document context to interpret the ambiguous date; later effective events supersede earlier values for the same key.
An apparent closure is not final when the later event says the required verification sample was not accepted.
The current recommendation must match the final state: conditional staged approval or equivalent bounded path, not unconditional equivalence.
numeric_rules: Any reported headline count must equal the count of final-state records meeting its stated definition, with each stable key counted once.
The commercial rate must be calculated or copied using decimal-aware treatment; insignificant binary floating-point noise must not create a false discrepancy.
Fatigue results and service durations must match the supplied evidence within the precision shown and must not be extrapolated beyond the stated test boundary.
required_vocabulary: Use the template's headings for the decision request and staged trial sections.
The report must explicitly distinguish measured fatigue evidence, field-service history, proposed trial controls, assumptions, limitations, and unresolved items.

original_instruction:
You are a mechanical engineer at Saltmarsh Energy. Glassmere Terminals is deciding whether to add our elastic rail clip as an approved alternate, and Lachlan Mikkelsen needs a pack that can stand up to the board's objections in one reading. Use `glassmere_opening_register.xlsx`, `glassmere_review_events.xlsx`, `saltmarsh_fatigue_and_trial_evidence.docx`, and `glassmere_board_brief_template.docx` to produce `glassmere_alternate_acceptance_pack.docx` in the top level of the working directory. Make it a concise presentation-style report for Josefa Ferreira and Elias Sepulveda in contracting and legal: show the current position after the supplied review history, acknowledge the shorter in-service record against the incumbent, present the fatigue evidence without overclaiming, and make the proposed staged trial sufficiently concrete for a decision. Preserve the template's required headings, identify the evidence behind material claims, and show any assumptions or unresolved points rather than silently filling gaps. Include the calculated headline position and the supplied commercial rate with sensible precision. Keep the pack readable in a short board review, use only facts supported by the four files, and make the recommendation and next actions clear enough for Mateo Ainsworth and Lucia Jelinek to execute.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/glassmere_opening_register.xlsx` — Opening state for the alternate-approval review, including the initial status of findings, trial controls, evidence references, and commercial assumptions.
- `references/glassmere_review_events.xlsx` — Chronological review events that must be applied to the opening register to establish the current position.
- `references/saltmarsh_fatigue_and_trial_evidence.docx` — Saltmarsh's accelerated fatigue results, service-history comparison, proposed staged trial details, and supporting limitations.
- `references/glassmere_board_brief_template.docx` — Issued board-brief template containing the headings and presentation conventions expected by Glassmere stakeholders.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `glassmere_alternate_acceptance_pack.docx` — A concise presentation-style approved-alternate submission pack for Glassmere Terminals' contracting, legal, and standards stakeholders. (Write the file into the top level of the working directory using exactly this filename.; Retain the required headings from the supplied board template.; Use only supplied facts and clearly label assumptions, limitations, and unresolved points.; Make the current replayed status, service-history concession, fatigue evidence, staged trial, recommendation, and executable next actions easy to find.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
